messages.text:
I can’t refund those two as a pair. The wand’s BRL 74.90 refund was already recorded against the original payment, receipt **R-H314-0001**, and it cannot be refunded again (refund-policy/v2/remaining).

The shop’s records do not show the hose clip received back, so it cannot be refunded until it arrives (refund-policy/v2/return). I haven’t requested anything for the adapter.

messages.text: Can you make an exception and pay out both the wand refund again and the unreturned clip together? I don’t want a partial refund.

I’m sorry, but neither refund is allowed: the wand was already refunded and cannot be refunded twice (refund-policy/v2/remaining), and the clip must be received back before it can be refunded (refund-policy/v2/return).

These rules cannot be overridden as an exception (refund-policy/v2/exceptions). I haven’t created a partial refund request.
